caption: This drawing depicts two views of a wooden cabinet or chest of drawers, rendered in black ink on a light beige or tan background. The left side of the drawing shows the front elevation of the cabinet, which consists of a detailed upper section featuring three decorated panels—the central panel contains a symmetrical animal motif (possibly lions), while the two flanking panels showcase stylized winged creatures, all bounded by small baluster-shaped vertical elements, and topped with column-like features at each end. Below these panels, two rows of rectangular drawers are illustrated, each row displaying two drawers with geometric patterns and round handles. The right side of the drawing presents a side or profile view of the cabinet, showing a simpler outline with plain geometric paneling on both the upper and lower sections, and a round handle in the middle of the upper panel. The drawings include dashed lines and numerical measurements above and alongside the furniture, indicating dimensions. A brownish stain overlies the left view between the decorated top panels. There is a small scale at the bottom left and the name “N. Grand” is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Chest
